items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Jack Lindstrom sounded like Mud Carey then, huh? ... Yeah. But Lindstrom nowadays, he plays mostly like Armstrong nowadays.

ctx.x: Jack Lindstrom sounded like Mud Carey then, huh?
Yeah. But Lindstrom nowadays, he plays mostly like Armstrong nowadays. Mm-hm. And his band is kind of modernized.
